extra.message: User-controlled query parameter 'host' is concatenated directly into a shell command passed to os.system("ping -c 1 " + host). An attacker can inject arbitrary shell commands (e.g. host='127.0.0.1; cat /etc/passwd') resulting in remote command execution.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

extra.message: pickle.loads() is called on raw bytes taken directly from the request body or the 'blob' query parameter (optionally base64-decoded). Deserializing attacker-controlled pickle data allows arbitrary code execution.

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: User-controlled 'fragment' query parameter is concatenated into a Jinja2 Template source and rendered. This is server-side template injection allowing template expression evaluation and potential remote code execution (e.g. {{ self.__init__.__globals__ }}).

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: User-controlled 'endpoint' query parameter is passed directly to urllib.request.urlopen(), and the response body is returned to the caller. This is server-side request forgery allowing attackers to probe internal network services and read their responses.

extra.message: lxml XMLParser is configured with load_dtd=True, resolve_entities=True, no_network=False and parses the raw request body. This enables XML External Entity (XXE) attacks, allowing local file disclosure and outbound network requests.

extra.message: Attacker-controlled JSON payload ('filter' or the whole body) is passed directly as a MongoDB query filter to find_one(). Operator injection (e.g. {"$gt": ""}) allows NoSQL injection to bypass query logic and extract records.

cwe: CWE-943: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic
